items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Barry was a nice guy, I liked him... we were all friends.

ctx.x: If you could do it with a trumpet it would be valid.

I said Barry, I understand what you're saying, but I don't agree with you. Of course I can use the razzer, that's exactly the sound I want, and what else could infer the inference that I want to make. 'You can't do it.' I didn't want to argue so I said all right. I had a contrabassoon there, so I said take it off the drums and contrabassoon, play your lowest note at that time. So I got my razzer out of the contrabassoon.
